description: Cross-node login grant signing (avalon_protocol::cross_node_login::signing_bytes). A CrossNodeLoginGrant is a short, self-signed assertion an already-registered identity mints with its own Ed25519 event-signing key to log into a node it has never registered a passkey on. Each SDK must derive byte-for-byte identical signing bytes and an identical Ed25519 signature from the same inputs and signing key. The identity id is the self-certifying id derived from the file's signing public key.

notSupported.rust: the SDK has not adopted self-certifying identity ids yet: its copy of this vector still carries a UUID identity id, so asserting it would diverge from the protocol until the SDK slice lands.
